regions.label: Credit decoder
regions.note: Unfolds his signature: each of the 65 bytes at 01AB minus a key of 4, 5, 6 and on.

regions.label: Header reader
regions.note: EGA graphics, then the 5 header bytes go into the player's own code.

regions.label: Command decoder and stroke drawer
regions.note: His screensaver player, with two new commands: z and 88h.

regions.label: Pause (88h)
regions.note: A pause of 4,096 key checks, then EGA mode again for a clean screen and the next picture.

regions.label: End (z)
regions.note: The same pause, text mode, his unfolded signature printed by DOS, then back to DOS.

regions.label: Folded signature
regions.note: 65 bytes that become "K E M Y A M Software Corp., <c>1991 YASSER MOHAMED ALI." at start-up.

regions.label: Script: the name
regions.note: طاهر ابراهيم الصرفي in one line: header 4B 43 00 07 04, 901 strokes, 297 column steps, then z.

routines.name: decode_credit
routines.note: Each byte minus a key that grows by one.

routines.name: draw_script
routines.note: The screensaver player with a pause, a next picture and an end.
